claim_boundary: A public reference dataset and adapter/normalisation verification case. The adapter reads the published table as an input; it does not independently predict reactivity or validate a fusion solver. Qualification covers inspected table entries and the elementary pair-counting equation only.

derivation.density_origin: Arbitrary documented input fixtures, not measured device data.
derivation.frozen_method: Separately transcribed SI decimals and 60-digit Decimal arithmetic using analytically simplified pair-density factors; producer not imported or executed to make expected values.
derivation.identical_particles: delta12=1 for DD and 0 for DT/DHe3. DD total event rate is not deuteron consumption rate or neutron emission rate.
derivation.tolerance_scope: Binary floating-point conversion/multiplication regression only. Not physical model uncertainty.

rights.distribution_scope: Only cited numerical facts, scientific formulae and original adapter/verification code are distributed. Full PDFs, copied publication prose, figures and external program code are excluded.
rights.external_material_license_claim: No blanket redistribution permission or open-source licence is asserted for either publication.

nrl-2023.admitted_content: 30 numerical table entries plus their temperature coordinates, reaction identities and physical units; no publication prose or figures.
nrl-2023.citation: A. Beresnyak, 2023 NRL Plasma Formulary, Naval Research Laboratory (2023).
nrl-2023.hash_scope: Exact official PDF bytes, identified but not redistributed.
locations: p.45 (PDF physical page 46): Maxwellian reaction-rate table, first three reaction columns
nrl-2023.model_uncertainty: The table does not provide per-point uncertainties. Display precision is recorded separately and is not a physical error bar.
nrl-2023.regime: Maxwellian averaged reactivity at the ten listed ion temperatures; no interpolation, extrapolation or drift/anisotropy model.

xie-2023-pair-counting.admitted_content: Only mathematical event-rate relation R12=n1*n2*reactivity/(1+delta12). No reactivity fits, tables, code or figures from this paper are imported.
xie-2023-pair-counting.citation: H. Xie, M. Tan, D. Luo, Z. Li and B. Liu, Fusion Reactivities with Drift bi-Maxwellian Ion Velocity Distributions, arXiv:2212.01840v2 (2023).
xie-2023-pair-counting.hash_scope: Exact version 2 arXiv PDF bytes, identified but not redistributed.
locations: p.2, Eq. (1), and definition of delta_12 immediately below
